indication.text: ANORO ELLIPTA is a combination anticholinergic/LABA indicated for the long-term, once-daily, maintenance treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with COPD, including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.

citations.quote: ANORO ELLIPTA is a combination anticholinergic/long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonist (anticholinergic/LABA) indicated for the long-term, once-daily, maintenance treatment of airflow obstruction in patients with chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), including chronic bronchitis and/or emphysema.

target_moa.text: Fixed-dose combination of umeclidinium, a long-acting antimuscarinic (anticholinergic) that inhibits the M3 receptor on airway smooth muscle to produce bronchodilation, and vilanterol, a long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonist (LABA) that stimulates intracellular adenylyl cyclase.

citations.quote: Umeclidinium is a long-acting, antimuscarinic agent, which is often referred to as an anticholinergic. It has similar affinity to the subtypes of muscarinic receptors M1 to M5. In the airways, it exhibits pharmacological effects through inhibition of M3 receptor at the smooth muscle leading to bronchodilation.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (incidence ≥1% and more common than placebo) include pharyngitis, sinusitis, lower respiratory tract infection, constipation, diarrhea, pain in extremity, muscle spasms, neck pain, and chest pain. detail.text: WARNING: ASTHMA-RELATED DEATH — LABA such as vilanterol increase the risk of asthma-related death; a salmeterol trial showed an increase in asthma-related deaths considered a class effect of all LABA. ANORO ELLIPTA is not indicated for the treatment of asthma.

citations.quote: Long-acting beta2-adrenergic agonists (LABA) increase the risk of asthma-related death. Data from a large placebo-controlled US trial that compared the safety of another LABA (salmeterol) with placebo added to usual asthma therapy showed an increase in asthma-related deaths in subjects receiving salmeterol. This finding with salmeterol is considered a class effect of all LABA, including vilanterol, one of the active ingredients in ANOROTM ELLIPTATM [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)].

vote.text: Pulmonary-Allergy Drugs Advisory Committee (PADAC) met September 10, 2013; voted 13 yes, 0 no, 0 abstain on substantial evidence of efficacy; 10 yes, 3 no, 0 abstain on adequate safety; and 11 yes, 2 no, 0 abstain in favor of approval for airflow obstruction in COPD.

citations.quote: the Committee voted favorably regarding whether there was substantial evidence of efficacy for airflow obstruction in COPD (13 yes, 0 no, 0 abstain), and whether the safety of Anoro had been adequately demonstrated (10 yes, 3 no, and 0 abstain). Regarding the approvability question, which is essentially the sum of the demonstration of efficacy and safety, the results were in favor of approval for airflow obstruction in COPD (11 yes, 2 no, 0 abstain).
